_comment: Feature -> forbidden-claim table for the documentation drift check in
scripts/verify.ps1 (roadmap W-13).
A claim is reported only when the feature it contradicts really exists in
the repository, so this table cannot rot into a list of stale assertions:
the check is driven by what the checkout contains, not by what the table
says about it.
feature   path that must exist for the claims below to be illegal.
claims    substrings that must then not appear in a live document.
context   optional. The claim only counts on a line that also contains
one of these strings, for platform-specific wording that is
still true for a different platform one line further down.
note      what to write instead; printed next to the finding.
No section is exempt. A finished todo item records a conclusion about today
- what exists, and where it is verified - so it is checked like any other
sentence. The wording of the plan it replaced is history: it belongs to git
and to CHANGELOG.md, which is excluded for exactly that reason. A single line
can still be excused with ignore_marker, for a document that has to quote a
claim in order to explain why it is wrong.
Keep this file small. A rule belongs here only when the paired feature is
something the repository can check for itself.
